_comment: MKT-1 — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every tradeable market. Backend reads it via src/intelligence/market_registry.py; the frontend consumes a GENERATED module (webapp/lib/markets.generated.ts via scripts/gen_markets.mjs) — never a hand-copied list. Adding a market = ONE entry here (+ regenerate). Every scattered market enumeration (frontend perimeter, instrument labels, price decimals, calendar market filters, backend supported-instruments) derives from this. Order = display order in the market column/selector.

_fields.id: stable market identifier used everywhere in code + URLs (e.g. XAUUSD).
_fields.label: FR baseline human label (i18n rendering uses the markets.<id> messages key when present; this is the fallback).
_fields.symbol: data-provider symbol (Twelve Data). Equals id today but kept distinct so an id can diverge from a provider symbol as the catalogue grows.
_fields.type: asset class — one of metal | fx | crypto | index. Used for grouping/iconography.
_fields.priceDecimals: conventional display precision for a price on this market.
_fields.glyph: short (1-2 char) mono badge shown in the compact market row.
_fields.timeframes: the perimeter timeframe ids this market is served on (ids MUST exist in config/timeframes.json). The M1 gate (NEXT_PUBLIC_LB1_ENABLE_M1 / LB1_ENABLE_M1) still applies on top as a global display filter.

_news_rule: driver_currencies (which currencies' macro news attach to a market) are NOT duplicated here — they live in config/event_market_map.json, the single consultable news-attachment rule read by src/intelligence/calendar_service.py. market_registry.driver_currencies() references that file. This registry describes market identity/display; event_market_map.json describes the news rule.
